# Essentia.js 0.1.3 (our own copy)

From the npm package `essentia.js@0.1.3` (https://github.com/MTG/essentia.js), files from its `dist/` folder, unchanged:
`essentia-wasm.web.js`, `essentia-wasm.web.wasm`, `essentia.js-core.umd.min.js`.

Essentia and Essentia.js: Copyright (C) 2006-2021 Music Technology Group, Universitat Pompeu Fabra. Licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 (`LICENSE`), like Open Music Tools.

Kept here instead of loading from a CDN (Drephie, 2026-11-20) so no outside site sees visitors. Used by `shared/analysis-worker.js` only.
